data.gender_notes: Ateebah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ateebah is derived from the Arabic root ataba, which means 'to submit' or 'to obey'. This beautiful name is a reminder of the importance of obedience to Allah and His Messenger (pbuh). The name Ateebah carries the meaning “Submissive, Obedient” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ateebah usually hope their child will grow to embody submissive, obedient and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ateebah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Submissive, Obedient.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ateebah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
